latest.content:

GETECH Group plc
25 August 2026
25 August 2026
Getech Group PLC
("Getech" or the "Company")
Appointment of Non-Executive Director
Getech, a leading locator of subsurface resources, is pleased to announce the appointment of Ajay Kejriwal as Independent Non-Executive Director, effective 24th August 2026.
Ajay has over 35 years of operational experience in corporate finance, natural resources and energy companies. His career spans both executive and non-executive roles across listed and private companies, including as CFO, Interim CEO and Audit Committee Chair. Ajay currently serves on multiple Boards, including Reon Energy Limited, Chesterfield Resources plc (LON: CHF) and ASX-listed, Apollo Minerals (ASX:AON), while previously serving on the Board of Sirius Petroleum plc and Upstream Asia plc. He holds a BSc in Economics and Accounting from City University, London and is an ACA Chartered Accountant.
On appointment, Ajay will also take on the role of Audit & Risk Committee Chair, where his previous experience of financial reporting and risk management will be of great value to the Company.
Michael Covington, Chair of Getech, said:
"On behalf of the Board, I am pleased to welcome Ajay Kejriwal to Getech, and I am confident his knowledge and experience in the natural resources sector is a great fit with the Company. In his role as Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee, Ajay's deep understanding of corporate finance and his experience in driving shareholder value will be invaluable as we look to continue commercial momentum and profit from the opportunities which lie ahead for Getech.
We would also like to extend our sincere thanks to Alyson Levitt for her commitment and support to the business over her tenure on the Board as Chair of Audit & Risk Committee, over which time we have seen solid growth and positive transformation."
Additional Information:

Getech provides trusted subsurface and geospatial insight to organisations across the global natural resources sector. We help corporates, governments, and regulators find and manage the subsurface resources essential to the evolving energy and minerals landscape by combining unique global earth‑science data, leading geospatial expertise and advanced analytics. Our solutions reduce risk, accelerate opportunities and enhance project value throughout the resource lifecycle, supporting activity across oil and gas, critical minerals, geothermal, natural hydrogen and other emerging resource domains.

Getech Group plc
("Getech" or the "Company")
Directors and PCA Dealings
Getech (AIM: GTC), a leading locator of subsurface resources, has received notification of the following transactions in the Company's ordinary shares of 0.25p each ("Ordinary Shares").
On 11 August 2026, Michael Covington, Non-Executive Chairman of Getech, gifted 664,375 Ordinary Shares, for nil consideration, to his wife Philippa Covington, a person closely associated with him.
On 12 August 2026, in order to effect "Bed and ISA" transactions, Michael Covington sold 664,375 Ordinary Shares at a price of 3.0000p each before subsequently acquiring 664,375 Ordinary Shares at a price of 3.0045p each within an Individual Savings Account. On the same date and on the same terms, Philippa Covington sold 664,375 Ordinary Shares at a price of 3.0000p each before subsequently acquiring 664,375 Ordinary Shares at a price of 3.0045p each within an Individual Savings Account.
Following these transactions, Michael Covington is beneficially interested in 714,192 Ordinary Shares, representing c. 0.47 per cent of the Company's issued share capital, comprising 664,375 Ordinary Shares held within an Individual Savings Account and 49,817 Ordinary Shares held within a self-invested personal pension. Philippa Covington is beneficially interested in 664,375 Ordinary Shares, representing c. 0.44 per cent of the Company's issued share capital.
The aggregate beneficial interest of Michael Covington and Philippa Covington is 1,378,567 Ordinary Shares, representing c. 0.90 per cent of the Company's issued share capital. This is unchanged from the position prior to the transactions described above. No Ordinary Shares have been sold outside the family holding.
